question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for the blank in the sentence below.

Despite being wealthy, Rohan couldn't resist stealing small items from stores, suggesting he might be a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Kleptomaniac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Kleptomaniac"** refers to a person who has a compulsive urge to steal, even though they may not need the stolen items. (चोरी की आदत से ग्रस्त व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite her wealthy background, Sarah couldn’t resist her kleptomaniac tendencies and stole small trinkets from the store.
 
 
• In the context of the question, Rohan’s inability to resist stealing small items from stores suggests he suffers from kleptomania. (चोरी करने की आदत)
 
 
• **Example:** Rohan, being a kleptomaniac, often stole items he didn’t even need.
 
 
• Hence, the correct word to fill the blank is **Kleptomaniac**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Kleptomaniac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philanthropist** (दानवीर): A person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, especially by donating money to good causes.
 
 
• **Example:** The philanthropist donated millions to build schools in underprivileged areas.
 
 
 
• **Pessimist** (निराशावादी): A person who tends to see the worst aspect of things or believes that the worst will happen.
 
 
• **Example:** As a pessimist, John always expected his projects to fail.
 
 
 
• **Hypochondriac** (स्वास्थ्य को लेकर अत्यधिक चिंतित व्यक्ति): A person who is abnormally anxious about their health and constantly fears having serious illnesses.
 
 
• **Example:** As a hypochondriac, she visited the doctor every week for minor symptoms.
